description: This file contains utility functions for testing address tracking on Linux, including creating netlink messages for addresses, links, and wireless links, and defining operators and classes related to netlink message handling.

classes.name: NetlinkMessage
classes.description: A class for constructing and managing netlink messages.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::NetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the netlink message buffer with a specific type.

methods.description: Adds payload data to the netlink message.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::AddAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the netlink message.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::AppendTo
methods.description: Appends the constructed message to an output buffer.

methods.name: NetlinkMessage::Append
methods.description: Appends raw data to the message buffer.
